children: HCW Biologics announced it will remove Proposal No. 2 (an amended performance-based equity plan) from its preliminary proxy and reschedule the special meeting.
Filed Amendment No. 1 to Preliminary Proxy Statement to amend and restate the Sept. 8, 2026 filing.
Board decided not to seek stockholder approval of Proposal No. 2 after stockholder feedback, removing the performance-based equity plan proposal.
Amendment changes the special meeting date, the record date, and certain other dates in the original PRE 14A.
No other substantive changes were made to the Original PRE 14A beyond those described.
